title: Teddy and Peddy’s Magic Frog Picnic
custom_script:
# Scene: bedroom (sitting)
Teddy: {wake} {stretch} Peddy, wake up! Today is our big *picnic* day! [excited, wave, shout, ding]
Peddy: {rub-eyes} {yawn} Five more minutes… wait, picnic? {jump} I'm up! [happy, point, excited]
Teddy: {idea} Sandwiches, juice, cake… we pack everything! [happy, point, excited]
Peddy: {hmm} And cookies. Lots of cookies. A mountain of cookies! [happy, think]
Teddy: {laugh} Okay, okay, cookies too. Let's go raid the kitchen! [happy, wave, laugh]
Peddy: {yay} Picnic, picnic, picnic! {dance} [happy, wave, excited]
# Scene: kitchen
Mom: {walk-to} Good morning, my little picnic monsters! {smile} [happy, wave]
Teddy: {hug} Good morning, Mom! We need food. All the food. [happy, wave]
Mom: {laugh} The normal sandwiches are on the table. Take those. [happy, point]
Teddy: {open:fridge} {sniff} Mom, what is this green sandwich glowing in here? [suspicious, point]
Mom: {shock} Don't touch that! It's Grandpa's *magic sandwich*! [surprised, hips, shout, gasp]
Peddy: {haan} Magic? What does it do? [suspicious, think]
Mom: Nobody knows. Grandpa ate one and croaked all week! {shake-head} [angry, hips]
Teddy: {gasp} Croaked? Like a frog? [surprised, shrug]
Mom: {nod} Like a very loud frog. So leave it alone, okay? [angry, point]
Mom: {walk-out} I'm going to water the plants. Be good! [normal, wave, footsteps]
Peddy: {tiptoe} {pick:sandwich} Just one tiny bite later… for science. [suspicious, shrug, whisper]
Teddy: {facepalm} Peddy, no! That is a terrible idea. [sad, facepalm, slap]
Peddy: {giggle} Relax! I'll only look at it. Promise. [happy, shrug, giggle]
# Scene: living room
Teddy: {carry:basket} Okay, basket is full. Juice, cake, normal sandwiches. [happy, point]
Peddy: {look-around} {hide} Shh! Is Mom watching? [suspicious, think, whisper]
Teddy: {hmm} Why are you hiding behind the sofa? [suspicious, hips]
Peddy: No reason! Totally normal hiding. {smile} [happy, shrug]
Teddy: {sigh} You took the green sandwich, didn't you? [sad, hips]
Peddy: {oops} Maybe. A little. It's in the basket. [surprised, shrug]
Teddy: {uff} If you turn into a frog, I'm not carrying you! [angry, point, shout]
# Scene: neighbourhood
Teddy: {carry:basket} This basket is heavier than me! {sweat} [sad, idle, footsteps]
Peddy: {look-around} Walk faster before Mom sees us! [suspicious, point, whisper]
Dog: {show:dog} {bark} Woof! I smell something magic! [excited, point, shout]
Teddy: {step-back} {scared} Nice doggy… go away, doggy! [surprised, shrug, shout]
Dog: {sniff} Hmm, green bread? No thanks, I like bones. {walk-out} [suspicious, think]
Peddy: {laugh} Even the dog is scared of it! [happy, point, laugh]
Teddy: {shake-head} That's not funny. That's a warning! [angry, hips]
# Time skip: Ten minutes later…
# Scene: park (sitting)
Peddy: {wow} Look at this place! Trees, birds, and a pond! [happy, point, excited]
Teddy: {drop:basket} {uff} Finally! My arms are noodles now. [sad, shrug]
Peddy: {eat:sandwich} Mmm! Normal sandwich number one, done! [happy, idle, eat]
Teddy: {drink} Ahh, cold juice. This is the best day ever! [happy, wave, sip]
Peddy: {hmm} Now… for dessert. {show:sandwich} The glowing one! [suspicious, point, whisper]
Teddy: {shake-head} Peddy, Mom said NO! [angry, hips, shout]
Peddy: Just one bite. What could go wrong? {smile} [happy, shrug]
Teddy: {facepalm} Everything! Everything could go wrong! [sad, facepalm, shout]
Peddy: {oops} Too late! {eat} Crunch! [happy, shrug, eat]
# Scene: park
Peddy: {dizzy} Teddy… why is everything so… big? [surprised, think, magic]
Teddy: {gasp} PEDDY! {turn:Peddy:frog} [surprised, point, shout, magic]
Peddy: {ribbit} Ribbit?! Why is my voice so croaky? [surprised, shrug, shout]
Teddy: {aah} You are a FROG! A green, jumpy frog! [surprised, point, shout, scream]
Peddy: {cry} I don't want to eat flies forever! [sad, shrug, cry]
Teddy: {pace} Don't panic. Think, Teddy, think! {think} [suspicious, think]
Peddy: {jump} I can't stop jumping! Boing! Boing! [surprised, shrug, boing]
Teddy: {laugh} Sorry… sorry, it's a little bit funny. [happy, shrug, giggle]
Peddy: {angry} It is NOT funny! Ribbit! [angry, hips, shout]
Cat: {show:cat} {meow} Ooh, a juicy little frog for my breakfast! [happy, point, excited]
Peddy: {scared} {hide} Teddy, help! The cat wants to eat me! [surprised, shrug, shout, scream]
Teddy: {run} Shoo, cat! That frog is my best friend! {chase} [angry, point, shout, footsteps]
Cat: {hiss} Fine, fine! Nobody shares anything anymore. {walk-out} [angry, hips]
Peddy: {sigh} Thank you, Teddy. Now how do I turn back? [sad, think]
Teddy: {idea} Maybe the pond knows! Frogs love ponds! [happy, point, ding]
# Scene: park by the pond
Duck: {show:duck} {quack} Hello! Why is that little frog crying? [suspicious, point]
Teddy: {walk-to} She ate a magic sandwich. Can you help us? [sad, shrug]
Duck: {laugh} Easy! Magic washes off in water. Jump in! [happy, wave, laugh]
Peddy: {jump} Here I go! {swim:pond} [excited, wave, splash]
Peddy: {look-around} Still a frog! Still croaky! Ribbit! [sad, shrug, shout]
Duck: {oops} Oh, pond water is too lazy. You need waterfall water! [surprised, think]
Teddy: {shock} A waterfall? Where do we find one? [surprised, shrug]
Duck: {point} Past the farm, through the forest, over the bridge. [happy, point]
Peddy: {uff} That sounds very far for tiny frog legs. [sad, shrug]
Duck: {walk-to} Don't worry. I'll show you the way. Quack! [happy, wave]
# Time skip: Half an hour later…
# Scene: farm
Cow: {show:cow} {moo} Mooo! Who is stepping on my grass? [angry, hips, shout]
Teddy: {step-back} Sorry, Mrs. Cow! We're looking for the waterfall. [surprised, shrug]
Cow: {hmm} The waterfall? Why does a boy need a waterfall? [suspicious, think]
Peddy: {ribbit} Not him. Me! I'm a frog by accident! [sad, point]
Cow: {laugh} By accident? Let me guess. The green sandwich? [happy, point, laugh]
Teddy: {gasp} How did you know?! [surprised, shrug]
Cow: {nod} Grandpa came here last year. Croaking. Very loud. [happy, shrug]
Pig: {show:pig} {oink} He jumped in my mud puddle! Twice! [angry, hips, shout]
Peddy: {facepalm} Grandpa, what were you doing? [sad, facepalm]
Cow: {point} Go through the forest. Follow the river. You'll hear the waterfall. [happy, point]
Teddy: {wave} Thank you, Mrs. Cow! Thank you, Mr. Pig! [happy, wave]
# Scene: forest by the river
Teddy: {carry:log} {sweat} Why am I carrying a log? [sad, shrug, thud]
Peddy: {croak} To cross the river, silly! [happy, point]
Teddy: {drop:log} Oh wait, there is a bridge. {facepalm} [sad, facepalm, slap]
Peddy: {giggle} Frogs are smarter than boys today! [happy, point, giggle]
Teddy: {cross:bridge} Okay, smarty frog, hop on! [happy, wave, footsteps]
Monkey: {show:monkey} {climb:tree} Hey! Nobody passes without paying! [angry, hips, shout]
Teddy: {gasp} Paying? We only have… sandwiches. [surprised, shrug]
Monkey: {haan} Sandwiches? {nod} Okay, one sandwich, you may pass. [happy, point]
Peddy: {hmm} Give him the normal one, Teddy! Not the green one! [suspicious, point, whisper]
Teddy: {give:sandwich} Here. A normal one, I promise. [normal, idle]
Monkey: {eat:sandwich} {yay} Delicious! The waterfall is right ahead! [happy, wave, eat]
Duck: {quack} See? Almost there! Keep going! [happy, wave, excited]
# Scene: waterfall
Peddy: {wow} Look! The *waterfall*! It's sparkling! [excited, point, shout, magic]
Duck: {quack} {walk-to} Told you! Now jump in, little frog! [happy, wave]
Peddy: {scared} What if it's too cold? What if I sink? [surprised, shrug]
Teddy: {hug} You can do it. Frogs are great swimmers! [happy, wave]
Peddy: {jump} Wish me luck! {swim:waterfall} [excited, wave, splash]
Teddy: {sweat} {look-around} Peddy? Peddy! Are you okay? [surprised, think]
Peddy: {turn:Peddy:back} {yay} I'm ME again! No more ribbits! [happy, wave, shout, magic]
Teddy: {hug} {cry} I was so worried about you! [happy, wave, cry]
Duck: {clap} Hooray! Magic washed away! [happy, wave, applause]
# Scene: waterfall (sitting)
Teddy: {hmm} So… that sandwich really was magic. [suspicious, think]
Peddy: {nod} Very magic. Never eating green bread again! [happy, shake-head]
Teddy: {show:sandwich} Wait… there's still half left in the basket. [surprised, point]
Peddy: {shock} Throw it away, Teddy! [surprised, point, shout]
Teddy: {think} But… it smells so good. Like cookies and pizza together. [suspicious, think]
Peddy: {angry} TEDDY. Don't you dare! [angry, hips, shout]
Teddy: {oops} {eat} Oops… I was hungry! [surprised, shrug, eat]
Peddy: {facepalm} Oh no, not again! [sad, facepalm, slap]
# Scene: waterfall
Teddy: {dizzy} {become:frog} Ribbit?! [surprised, shrug, magic]
Peddy: {laugh} Now YOU are the frog! [happy, point, laugh]
Duck: {quack} {laugh} The waterfall is right there, froggy! [happy, point, laugh]
Teddy: {croak} This is so embarrassing. Don't tell anyone! [sad, shrug]
Peddy: {giggle} I'm telling everyone. [happy, point, giggle]
Teddy: {jump} {swim:waterfall} Here I go! [excited, wave, splash]
Teddy: {turn:Teddy:back} {wow} Back to normal! Ha! [happy, wave, magic]
Peddy: {high-five} Best picnic ever! [happy, wave, excited, applause]
Duck: {wave} Bye, frogs! I mean, bye, friends! {walk-out} [happy, wave]
# Time skip: That evening…
# Scene: kitchen
Mom: {hmm} So… where is Grandpa's magic sandwich? [suspicious, hips]
Teddy: {sweat} {look-around} Sandwich? What sandwich? [surprised, shrug, whisper]
Peddy: {smile} We… gave it to a monkey? [suspicious, shrug]
Mom: {angry} You ATE it, didn't you?! [angry, hips, shout]
Teddy: {nod} Just a little. And we turned into frogs. [sad, shrug]
Peddy: But the waterfall fixed us! Good as new! {smile} [happy, wave]
Mom: {sigh} Then you two can wash all the picnic plates. [angry, point]
Teddy: {uff} Being a frog was easier! [sad, facepalm, fail]
Peddy: {laugh} Ribbit! [happy, wave, laugh]
